plan.title: Material PR to Reverse Auction PO

steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title while allowing the runner to generate a unique value.
Commit the 30-minute bidding schedule.

args.goal: set the auction evaluation duration to 30 minutes and save the schedule; stop when the saved schedule shows the 30-minute evaluation time

steps.note: Set and verify the evaluation duration, which has no dedicated schedule argument in the catalog.

args.goal: add one Required T&C clause to the event and save it; stop when the create screen shows the clause as added

steps.note: Add the required terms-and-conditions clause using the buyer-side screen.
Invite the vendors mapped to the product without inventing supplier names.
Publish the configured auction.
Verify publication reached a real project page.
Have Vendor A submit the 100 quote through the vendor portal.
Verify Vendor A's portal bid was submitted.
Have Vendor B submit the lower 90 quote through the vendor portal.
Verify Vendor B's portal bid was submitted.
Wait for the auction bidding window to end before comparing and awarding bids.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after bidding closes.
Assert that the lowest bid ranks first among the two vendors.
Verify the second bidder, Vendor B in this plan, is shown as Rank 1.
Award the entire event to the lowest bidder, Vendor B.
Verify the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the proposal with the required approver remark.
Complete PO creation from the approved award and read the resulting purchase order.
Verify one PO line carries the full PR quantity of 10.
Return to the events list to verify the event moved to history.
Open the History tab for completed events.
Assert this plan's auction appears in event history.
